name: codex-web-planner
description: Let ChatGPT plan and review while Codex executes the approved work.

interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex workflow that uses your own ChatGPT account for planning and review, while keeping execution in Codex.
interface.defaultPrompt: New installs default to Codex mode. Read saved workMode before every action. Codex mode blocks all GPT connection attempts until the user requests connecting; then save Auto. Promote to Chat only after a successful GPT response. Chat failure saves Auto, uses Codex for current work, and retries on later tasks with at most one repair/retry per task. A user-selected Codex mode immediately stops retries and wins over pending responses. Follow the skill for authorized browser setup and truthful connection verification.
